daemon_interval.description: Interval in seconds between dynamic DNS update checks. Minimum 60, typical 300 (5 minutes).

log_file.description: Path to a log file. Leave empty to log only to syslog.

protocol.description: Default DNS service protocol to use (e.g., dyndns2, namesilo, cloudflare).

default_server.description: Default DynDNS provider server address (used if per-host server not specified).

use_ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS for secure connections where supported by the protocol.

default_login.description: Default username for DNS provider authentication. May be overridden per host.

default_password.description: Default password or API key for DNS provider authentication. May be overridden per host.

hosts.description: List of hostnames (and associated options) to update.

hostname.description: Fully qualified domain name to update.

ip_source.description: Source for local IP address: 'web' (auto-detect via web), 'if=eth0' (interface), 'if=lo' (loopback), etc.

password.description: Per-host password or API key override (optional).

protocol.description: Per-host protocol override (optional); if empty, uses global protocol.
